answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 4 graders each stake 42 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. The sable is the check that cannot be faked, the jade is the price the attacker pays, and the tundra is the record that outlives the epoch.
